extracted.intended_audience: Chief, Executive and Planning Division; Office of Security (internal agency staff)
extracted.subtask_short: agency management memo on A-44 response
extracted.subtask_description: An internal memorandum providing data for inclusion in the Office of Security's reply to implementation of OMB Circular A-44 (Revised). It reports items under the Circular's Section I (Management Effectiveness Goals) and Section II (Cost Reduction Goals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Section I of OMB Circular A-44 reporting: report changes that increase management effectiveness. The attached memorandum itemizes a change in scheduling and timing of the Security Education Program that enabled one Training Officer to deliver the entire program where two were previously required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe managerial improvements such as staff reallocation and increased ability to participate in other briefings/training. Note that an increase in management effectiveness may occur even if there is no immediate cost reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Section II of OMB Circular A-44 reporting: report cost reduction outcomes. In this memorandum the staff submits a negative report on cost reduction goals—no overall cost reduction resulted from the scheduling change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no cost reductions are realized, explicitly submit a negative report. Distinguish between operational/managerial efficiencies and measurable cost savings when reporting under this section.
